hazards.evidence: Knives are placed on the counter in an accessible location, posing a risk if the individual with dementia attempts to use them unsupervised.
Medication bottles are left out on the counter, which could be mistaken for food or other items, leading to accidental ingestion or misuse.
The stove knobs are freely accessible and there is no visible safety lock, posing a risk of accidental burns or fires if the individual with dementia turns on the stove.
Cleaning chemicals are visible on the counter, which could be mistaken for food or drink, leading to accidental poisoning.
